title: Language model architecture and system taxonomy
scope: Representative families known through 2025, with a separate speculative placeholder for 2026–2500.
warning: This is a curated taxonomy, not a count of 2,000–2,500 distinct models and not an exhaustive catalogue of products or checkpoints.

entries.name: Statistical language model
entries.description: Predicts tokens from local frequency context; useful baseline, limited long-range structure.

entries.name: Probabilistic sequence model
entries.description: Models hidden states and observed token sequences; historically important for speech and NLP.

entries.name: Structured prediction
entries.description: Labels sequences using contextual feature dependencies in classical NLP pipelines.

entries.name: Neural language model
entries.description: Predicts a token from a fixed context window using dense neural layers.

entries.name: Recurrent neural network
entries.description: Processes sequences with recurrent state; foundational neural sequence architecture.

entries.name: Gated recurrent network
entries.description: Uses input, forget, and output gates to retain information over longer sequences.

entries.name: Gated recurrent network
entries.description: A streamlined gated recurrent architecture with update and reset gates.

entries.name: Encoder-decoder sequence model
entries.description: Maps an input sequence to an output sequence, often with recurrent or transformer components.

entries.name: Attention-based encoder-decoder
entries.description: Allows decoder steps to focus on relevant encoded input positions.

entries.name: Bidirectional encoder
entries.description: Uses self-attention and feed-forward blocks for contextual representations; BERT-style family.

entries.name: Autoregressive decoder
entries.description: Uses causal self-attention to predict the next token; GPT-style family.

entries.name: Text-to-text transformer
entries.description: Uses an encoder and autoregressive decoder for translation, summarization, and general text tasks.

entries.name: Conditional-compute model
entries.description: Routes tokens or examples to a subset of expert networks to scale capacity with conditional computation.

entries.name: Retrieval-grounded model system
entries.description: Combines a language model with search or document retrieval; retrieved evidence is distinct from model weights.

entries.name: Extended-context model
entries.description: Uses attention variants, memory, or position strategies to process longer sequences.

entries.name: State-space sequence model
entries.description: Uses structured state-space dynamics or selective scans as an alternative to full attention in some settings.

entries.name: Hybrid sequence model
entries.description: Combines attention layers with state-space or recurrent components.

entries.name: Multimodal model
entries.description: Connects text with image, audio, video, or other modality encoders and decoders.

entries.name: Audio/speech model
entries.description: Processes or generates speech/audio, sometimes through discrete audio tokens or aligned encoders.

entries.name: Code-specialized model
entries.description: Trains on source code and text for completion, explanation, transformation, and tool-assisted coding.

entries.name: Vision-text model
entries.description: Aligns visual representations with language for image understanding and visual question answering.

entries.name: Generative hybrid
entries.description: Combines language modeling with diffusion-style generation or refinement; implementations vary.

entries.name: Tool-using model system
entries.description: Combines an LLM with planning, tools, memory, and feedback loops; system design rather than a single neural architecture.

entries.name: Continual adaptation system
entries.description: Updates or adapts from sequential data while attempting to limit catastrophic forgetting.

entries.name: Brain-inspired computing model
entries.description: Explores spiking or event-driven computation for language-related workloads.

entries.name: Compressed deployment variant
entries.description: Uses reduced-precision weights or activations to lower memory and compute; orthogonal to base architecture.

entries.name: Compressed student model
entries.description: Transfers behavior from a larger teacher to a smaller model; orthogonal to base architecture.

entries.name: Distributed training system
entries.description: Trains across decentralized data holders with aggregation and privacy constraints; a training topology, not an architecture.

entries.name: Hybrid symbolic-neural system
entries.description: Combines neural language processing with explicit rules, logic, knowledge graphs, or verifiers.

entries.name: Speculative category
entries.description: Potential post-2025 systems through 2500 cannot be catalogued as known facts; record proposals separately with evidence and uncertainty.
